title: Three Months and One Short Policy
subtitle: 损害评估 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 损害评估（人与自然·灾害防范·损害与评估）
meta: 主题语境：损害评估（人与自然·灾害防范·损害与评估）　|　核心词汇：insurance　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 insurance 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1991 the adjuster ① bought the insurance that no owner in the building would have recorded, and he said the buying was the whole of the month. The ② insurance, meaning the cover itself and not the policy, ran three months and stayed unrecorded in the book; insurance, he said, is the only thing in a building that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ kind of insurance in that building had the same short policy beside it, and the ④ insurance at the far stair, meaning the claim they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Insurance, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the adjuster said the recording is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the insurance was the whole of the matter, meaning the safety and not the cover. The ⑥ insurance, meaning the safety and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; insurance, he said, is either something you buy or the only word that means both cover and a safety. He said the safety is the part they remember.

By 1996 the ⑦ insurance had become a line in a file, and the file had become an argument about the short policy. The ⑧ insurance of the whole thing, the adjuster wrote in May, was one building and three months of recording; insurance, he said, is either the claim at the far stair or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ insurance I remember is the insurance recorded in the file, which closed in 1998 and is still recorded as the quietest in the building. ⑩ Insurance, my mother said in 2000, is the only thing that improves by being recorded; all insurance, she said, is a safety that has agreed to look like cover. She said the safety was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 保险；保障（指楼宇里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 保险；保障（指那份保障本身，与保单相对）
C. 固定搭配：buy the insurance 购买这份保险
D. n. 保险；保障（指留给孩子们存着的一份那一份）
E. n. 投保之事（抽象总称，指一处楼宇的保险之事）
F. n. 保险；保障（指卷宗里写到、被记下的的那一份）
G. n. 安全、依靠（指一件事里人人都投却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 依靠（抽象总称，指人人都投却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: bought the insurance that no owner in the building would have recorded
The insurance, meaning the cover itself and not the policy
Every kind of insurance in that building
the insurance at the far stair

answers.why: buy the insurance 意为“购买这份保险”，1991 年那位理赔员把楼宇里没有一位业主肯记录的一份保险做了一遍。
insurance 意为“保险；保障”，指那份保障本身而不是保单，它经过了三个月而在簿子上没有被记录。
insurance 意为“保险；保障”，指楼宇里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一份薄薄的保单。
insurance 意为“保险；保障”，指最远那段楼梯留给孩子们存着的一份那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
insurance 意为“安全、依靠”，指一件事里人人都投却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份安全就是那件事的全部。
insurance 意为“依靠”，指人人都投却无人提起的那样东西而不是那份保障，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
insurance 意为“保险；保障”，指卷宗里写到、被记下的的那一份，到 1996 年这一份成了卷宗里的一行。
insurance 意为“投保之事”，理赔员五月写道，整件事的保险之事是一处楼宇和三个月的记录。
insurance 意为“保险；保障”，我记得的是卷宗里记录过的那一份，1998 年理赔了，至今仍被说成楼宇里最安静的一份。
insurance 为抽象总称，母亲 2000 年说，保险是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的保障。
